U.S. intelligence officers believe the businesswoman is a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security, the New York Times reported. CNBC's Eamon Javers breaks down what we know.

items.title: Trump says Iran war to end 'fairly soon,' plays down prospects of new strikes
items.content_text: “Iran militarily is effectively over,” Trump said, citing the destruction of its navy and surging inflation that he said has hollowed out Tehran's economy.
